subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Makes healthy food choices; discusses food groups and how much to eat from each

show.line: Healthy food helps us grow strong! Fruit, vegetables, pap, beans, eggs and milk.

rounds.prompt: Healthy food, or a treat? Sort them.

rounds.praise: Yes! A sandwich, fruit and water.

rounds.prompt: Name a fruit you like to eat.
We eat lots of these every day. Which one?
rounds.praise: Lots of vegetables. Only a little bit of treats.

hints: Healthy food grows or comes from farms.
Treats are nice, but just a little bit.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will pack a healthy lunch.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I pack sweets, chips and cake!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A healthy lunch has fruit and a sandwich.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's pack fruit, a sandwich and water!

parent_line: Can choose healthy foods and knows treats are for a little bit.
